topics.title: Pokemon Winds and Waves: Everything We know,  Leaks and Rumors.
Overworld Poké Ball Throwing Appears to Be Returning
topics.shortDescription: Newly surfaced development footage of Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves appears to confirm that players will once again be able to throw Poké Balls directly in the overworld. In the brief leaked gameplay footage, the player can be seen aiming and throwing a Poké Ball. The mechanic closely resembles the catching system introduced in Pokémon Legends: Arceus, where players could approach, aim at, and attempt to catch wild Pokémon while freely exploring the environment.

topics.title: Winds and Waves Starters: Everything We Know About Browt, Pombon, and Gecqua
topics.shortDescription: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves were officially revealed on February 27, 2026, introducing three completely new first-partner Pokémon: Browt, Pombon, and Gecqua. The games are being developed by Game Freak exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 and are scheduled for a worldwide release sometime in 2027.
